name: Steering Column & Intermediate Shafts
description: Collapsible tilt/telescope steering column mounted to the instrument-panel beam (or a cage dash bar in a race car), plus a two-piece intermediate shaft with U-joints that passes through the dash panel and down beside the engine to the rack pinion.

components.name: Steering column
components.description: Factory collapsible column with manual tilt/telescope, electric steering column lock module and the steering angle sensor/clockspring at the top. It bolts to the IP cross-car beam with nuts. Race builds either keep the OE column (crash-collapsible, retains SAS for ABS/stability) on a fabricated mount on the cage dash bar, or fit a lighter race column with a collapsible section.
components.location: From steering wheel approx (x 1.22, y 0.79, z +0.37) forward/down to approx (x 0.85, y 0.60, z +0.37).

factory.name: GM Gen 6 tilt/telescope collapsible column with electric column lock

raceOptions.name: OE column on fabricated cage-bar mount (common)
raceOptions.notes: Delete column lock module only if your electrical architecture allows (GM BCM may require it).

raceOptions.name: Collapsible race column
raceOptions.notes: Requires custom upper mount and I-shaft adaptation; retain collapsibility per rules where required.

hardware.item: Steering column mounting nut (to IP beam)
Steering column lock control module bolt
IP steering column lower trim cover bolt

installNotes: Position column so the wheel lands at the driver's seat/ergonomics point before welding a cage-mounted column bracket.
Keep the collapsible capsule free to stroke.
inspection: Check column mount for cracks and play.

images.title: Chevrolet 2019 Camaro ZL1 product guide (suspension types, ZF EPS, track 1610/1591 mm, DSSV, 3-way rear bar)

modelRef.features: Tilt/telescope column: steel jacket, cast upper housing with lock, mounting bracket with breakaway capsules

components.name: Upper intermediate steering shaft (with U-joints)
components.description: Shaft from the column output, through the dash panel boot, to the mid joint. Pinch-bolt clamped U-joint yokes on splines; the pinch bolts must pass through the spline groove.
components.location: From approx (x 0.85, y 0.60, z 0.37) through dash panel (x 0.66) to mid joint approx (x 0.40, y 0.42, z 0.40).

raceOptions.name: Borgeson / Woodward / Flaming River U-joints and DD shaft
raceOptions.notes: Use when relocating column or clearing headers/dry-sump; keep joint angles under approx 30-35 deg and phase joints correctly.

hardware.item: Upper intermediate steering shaft upper bolt (to column)

installNotes: Center the rack and steering wheel before assembling splines (wheel spokes level).
Never let the column/shaft spin freely with the airbag clockspring installed (damages clockspring).

images.title: 2017 Camaro ZL1 steering gear & linkage parts list

modelRef.features: U-joint shaft through the dash seal

components.name: Lower intermediate steering shaft (with U-joint to pinion)
components.description: Shaft from the mid joint down beside the engine (driver side, near the exhaust headers) to the rack pinion. Needs heat protection from headers on a race car.
components.location: From approx (x 0.40, y 0.42, z 0.40) to pinion approx (x -0.11, y 0.27, z 0.28).

raceOptions.name: Custom DD shaft + needle-bearing U-joints with heat shield
raceOptions.notes: Required if headers or dry-sump plumbing change the path.

hardware.item: Intermediate steering shaft lower bolt (to pinion)
hardware.spec: Pinch bolt through pinion spline groove

installNotes: Confirm pinch bolt passes through the spline groove (pull-test the joint).
inspection: Check for heat damage and joint play.

modelRef.features: U-joints both ends, slip section, down to the pinion on the driver end of the rack

components.name: Intermediate shaft dash-panel boot / seal
components.description: Rubber boot and seal plate where the intermediate shaft passes through the dash panel; keeps fumes, heat and fire out of the cockpit. Must be retained or replaced with a sealed race bearing plate.

images.title: 2017 Camaro ZL1 steering gear & linkage parts list

modelRef.features: Convoluted rubber boot in the dash panel pass-through

components.name: Steering angle sensor and clockspring (SIR coil)
components.description: Steering angle sensor (needed by StabiliTrak/ABS and EPS logic if the factory chassis electronics are kept) and the clockspring that carries airbag/button circuits to the OE wheel. With a race wheel and quick release the driver airbag is removed; the SRS system must be properly disabled per your electrical plan and rules. Keep the SAS if retaining factory ABS/ESC calibration.
components.location: Top of column behind steering wheel, approx (x 1.18, y 0.77, z 0.37).

factory.name: GM steering wheel position sensor + SIR coil
factory.notes: SAS calibration with a scan tool after alignment if retained.

raceOptions.name: Retain SAS, delete clockspring airbag circuits

installNotes: Lock clockspring centered before removing wheel; never rotate column with clockspring disconnected from the wheel.

modelRef.features: Round clockspring/steering-angle sensor module at the column top with connector
